thread:
sasha: Heads up — we're in a quick warroom for a customer-facing spike of 5xx/timeouts on hosted inference affecting multiple endpoints. stack: hosted-gateway -> runtime-pool. seeing ~40% p95 errors since 23:02 UTC. @miguel can you grab the live traces?

miguel: on it. tailing gateway logs now. noticed a surge of 429->502 cascades; lots of HTTP/1 keepalive resets. adding traces: `https://traces.redwood.corp/trace/8a7f`

jamie: i'm seeing rapid backlog growth in the batcher metrics, queue depth went from 20->450 in ~90s. suspect prefix cache misses + long seq lengths.

lina: customer report said timeouts started after a large nightly job around 22:50 UTC. could be tenant burst. i've pulled a sample request payload — typical chat completion with seqlen ~4k tokens.

miguel: repro attempt from internal tenancy: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -d @payload.json` returns 503 after 30s. attaching minimal logs:
```
gateway: upstream reset by peer
runtime: kv-cache-miss; batch flush @ 29.8s
batcher: open_batches=12; backlog=432
```

ash: incident-bot triggered runbook 'hosted-5xx' and posted initial mitigations. recommended actions: enable canary fallback, reduce max_batch_size, and temporarily increase runtime replicas.

sasha: proximate mitigation idea: enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant for the affected endpoint (m-fallback-qa) and force burst autoscale for 10m. need ops to approve.

jamie: +1 for fallback. also dropping max_batch_size from 64->16 reduced per-token latency in the canary (local sim). can push config change to Dedicated pool? we can patch hosted gateway config for the route.

miguel: I've flipped fallback routing for the customer's route and increased replicas by +30% (applied 23:14 UTC). monitoring now.

lina: early signs: p95 dropped from 12.8s -> 2.1s, 5xx rate down to ~2% from 42%. customers seeing fewer errors. continuing to monitor for 30m.

sasha: great. action items before we close warroom:
- miguel: collect full traces and upload to incident docket (deadline 10:00 PT)
- jamie: propose permanent throttle and batch config (PR + perf bench)
- lina: contact customer success with summary and temporary mitigation note
- ash: add runbook step for large-seqlen tenant detection and automated fallback policy

ash: noted and creating ticket INC-1771239999-FOLLOWUP. also scheduling postmortem sync 48h from now.

miguel: uploaded trace bundle + sample payloads to the docket: `s3://incidents/1771239999/traces.tar.gz`

jamie: started a draft PR to adjust max_batch_size heuristics and add seqlen-aware routing. will link when tests run.

lina: customer comm drafted, sending to Sasha for signoff.

sasha: signoff sent. thanks team — leaving this thread open for any residuals, otherwise we'll shift to the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Warroom closed by sasha at 23:45 UTC — followup ticket INC-1771239999-FOLLOWUP created.
